query: SELECT COUNT(*) as missing_from_resolved FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.estado = 'RECEBIDO' AND ar.liquidacaoData >= '2026-05-15' AND DATEDIFF(ar.liquidacaoData, ar.vencimentoData) >= 3 AND ar.id NOT IN (SELECT receivableId FROM resolved_receivables);
